name: TOKYO FREAK SHOW
source:
Tokyo, the city of swirling desires - in a corner of this city that never sleeps, a party for men is being held.
Members-only sex club 'FREAK SHOW', a large organisation said to have members from the political, financial and entertainment worlds. There, unusual play that can't be experienced in everyday life is put on for show...
